decisions.reason: The supplement range builds directly on the firm's established consumer health knowledge and pharmacy channels, so it can readily interpret early market feedback and refine the line.
This skin and hair supplement is closely related to the firm's existing supplement brand and pharmacy business, and its prominent launch page signals that management is committed to it.
This joint health product extends the established Trivital line, where the firm holds strong related knowledge in formulation, regulation, and marketing, making further improvement feasible.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is more of a niche concept and gets less visibility, but it still sits within the firm's supplement expertise, so learning from early results is manageable.

The valsartan generic is distant from the firm's core knowledge and was hit by the 2018 contamination recall, which creates supply-chain and regulatory uncertainty the firm is poorly placed to absorb, so withdrawing it frees resources for the core business.
